business_need_date.description: Documented business or control date that the decision must protect.

decision_timing_status.description: Use ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise use LATE.

due_date.description: Due date calculated from the effective trigger after invalid or duplicate inputs are removed.

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 because the third option is outside current authority; otherwise use 0.

excluded_measure.description: inactive assets, blackout dates, and duplicate forecasts

forecast_horizon_end.description: Last date inside the bounded generation horizon; it must not precede the safe window.

measure_unit.description: Unit used by the source measure and trigger: ASSETS.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the independently documented business/control date; positive means late.

program_or_asset_record.description: Immutable maintenance program or asset identifier.

qualifying_measure.description: assets with approved quarterly pattern and no existing forecast

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental spend or avoidable exposure of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing generate_bounded_forecast, forecast_all_asset_rows, defer_entire_quarter.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying all source constraints.

safe_window_start.description: First production-safe window on or after the controlled due date.

source_measure.description: eligible active compressors in the forecast horizon

trigger_threshold.description: Effective meter, event, due-row, or asset threshold that triggers the program action.
